Timezone offset calculation incorrect for SimpleTZ

When parsing GPX files with timezone information, the timezone offset calculation in SimpleTZ is producing incorrect results. The offset appears to be calculated incorrectly, causing timezone-aware datetime objects to have wrong UTC offsets.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import gpxpy
import datetime

# Parse GPX with timezone offset
xml = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx>
<trk>
<trkseg>
<trkpt lat="35.794159" lon="-5.832745"><time>2014-02-02T10:23:18+01:00</time></trkpt>
</trkseg></trk></gpx>'''

gpx = gpxpy.parse(xml)
point = gpx.tracks[0].segments[0].points[0]
print(f"Time: {point.time}")
print(f"UTC offset: {point.time.utcoffset()}")

# Expected UTC offset should be 1 hour (60 minutes)
# But actual result shows incorrect offset
```

The timezone parsing seems to be affecting both time formatting and timezone offset calculations when working with GPX timestamps that include timezone information.
